verses.en: The Sure Reality
What is the Sure Reality
And what will make thee realise what the Sure Reality is
The Thamud and the 'Ad People (branded) as false the Stunning Calamity
But the Thamud,- they were destroyed by a terrible Storm of thunder and lightning

verses.ar: وَاَمَّا عَادٌ فَاُهۡلِكُوۡا بِرِيۡحٍ صَرۡصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍۙ‏
verses.en: And the 'Ad, they were destroyed by a furious Wind, exceedingly violent

verses.ar: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَبۡعَ لَيَالٍ وَّثَمٰنِيَةَ اَيَّامٍۙ حُسُوۡمًا فَتَرَي الۡقَوۡمَ فِيۡهَا صَرۡعٰيۙ كَاَنَّهُمۡ اَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ خَاوِيَةٍۚ‏
verses.en: He made it rage against them seven nights and eight days in succession: so that thou couldst see the (whole) people lying prostrate in its (path), as they had been roots of hollow palm-trees tumbled down
Then seest thou any of them left surviving

verses.ar: وَجَآءَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَمَنۡ قَبۡلَهٗ وَالۡمُؤۡتَفِكٰتُ بِالۡخَاطِئَةِۚ‏
verses.en: And Pharaoh, and those before him, and the Cities Overthrown, committed habitual Sin

verses.ar: فَعَصَوۡا رَسُوۡلَ رَبِّهِمۡ فَاَخَذَهُمۡ اَخۡذَةً رَّابِيَةً
verses.en: And disobeyed (each) the messenger of their Lord; so He punished them with an abundant Penalty

verses.ar: اِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا الۡمَآءُ حَمَلۡنٰكُمۡ فِي الۡجَارِيَةِۙ‏
verses.en: We, when the water (of Noah's Flood) overflowed beyond its limits, carried you (mankind), in the floating (Ark)

verses.ar: لِنَجۡعَلَهَا لَكُمۡ تَذۡكِرَةً وَّتَعِيَهَا٘ اُذُنٌ وَّاعِيَةٌ
verses.en: That We might make it a Message unto you, and that ears (that should hear the tale and) retain its memory should bear its (lessons) in remembrance

verses.ar: فَاِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّوۡرِ نَفۡخَةٌ وَّاحِدَةٌۙ‏
verses.en: Then, when one blast is sounded on the Trumpet

verses.ar: وَّحُمِلَتِ الۡاَرۡضُ وَالۡجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَّاحِدَةًۙ‏
verses.en: And the earth is moved, and its mountains, and they are crushed to powder at one stroke
On that Day shall the (Great) Event come to pass
And the sky will be rent asunder, for it will that Day be flimsy

verses.ar: وَّالۡمَلَكُ عَلٰ٘ي اَرۡجَآئِهَاؕ وَيَحۡمِلُ عَرۡشَ رَبِّكَ فَوۡقَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ثَمٰنِيَةٌؕ‏
verses.en: And the angels will be on its sides, and eight will, that Day, bear the Throne of thy Lord above them

verses.ar: يَوۡمَئِذٍ تُعۡرَضُوۡنَ لَا تَخۡفٰي مِنۡكُمۡ خَافِيَةٌ
verses.en: That Day shall ye be brought to Judgment: not an act of yours that ye hide will be hidden

verses.ar: فَاَمَّا مَنۡ اُوۡتِيَ كِتٰبَهٗ بِيَمِيۡنِهٖ فَيَقُوۡلُ هَآؤُمُ اقۡرَءُوۡا كِتٰبِيَهۡۚ‏
verses.en: Then he that will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Ah here! Read ye my Record
I did really understand that my Account would (One Day) reach me
And he will be in a life of Bliss
In a Garden on high
The Fruits whereof (will hang in bunches) low and near

verses.ar: كُلُوۡا وَاشۡرَبُوۡا هَنِيۡٓـًٔاۭ بِمَا٘ اَسۡلَفۡتُمۡ فِي الۡاَيَّامِ الۡخَالِيَةِ
verses.en: Eat ye and drink ye, with full satisfaction; because of the (good) that ye sent before you, in the days that are gone

verses.ar: وَاَمَّا مَنۡ اُوۡتِيَ كِتٰبَهٗ بِشِمَالِهٖ ࣢ۙ فَيَقُوۡلُ يٰلَيۡتَنِيۡ لَمۡ اُوۡتَ كِتٰبِيَهۡۚ‏
verses.en: And he that will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: "Ah! Would that my Record had not been given to me
And that I had never realised how my account (stood)
Ah! Would that (Death) had made an end of me
Of no profit to me has been my wealth
My power has perished from me
(The stern command will say): "Seize ye him, and bind ye him
And burn ye him in the Blazing Fire

verses.ar: ثُمَّ فِيۡ سِلۡسِلَةٍ ذَرۡعُهَا سَبۡعُوۡنَ ذِرَاعًا فَاسۡلُكُوۡهُؕ‏
verses.en: Further, make him march in a chain, whereof the length is seventy cubits

verses.ar: اِنَّهٗ كَانَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِاللّٰهِ الۡعَظِيۡمِۙ‏
verses.en: This was he that would not believe in Allah Most High
And would not encourage the feeding of the indigent
So no friend hath he here this Day
Nor hath he any food except the corruption from the washing of wounds
Which none do eat but those in sin
So I do call to witness what ye see
And what ye see not
That this is verily the word of an honoured messenger

verses.ar: وَّمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَاعِرٍؕ قَلِيۡلًا مَّا تُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: It is not the word of a poet: little it is ye believe

verses.ar: وَلَا بِقَوۡلِ كَاهِنٍؕ قَلِيۡلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer: little admonition it is ye receive
(This is) a Message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds
And if the messenger were to invent any sayings in Our name
We should certainly seize him by his right hand
And We should certainly then cut off the artery of his heart

verses.ar: فَمَا مِنۡكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَحَدٍ عَنۡهُ حٰجِزِيۡنَ
verses.en: Nor could any of you withhold him (from Our wrath)
But verily this is a Message for the Allah-fearing
And We certainly know that there are amongst you those that reject (it)
But truly (Revelation) is a cause of sorrow for the Unbelievers
But verily it is Truth of assured certainty
So glorify the name of thy Lord Most High
